shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view.
- **MOUNTAIN RIVER HYDROLOGY (final spec, rounds 8-11):** water keys on IsWater (composites). A water cell is INSIDE the mountain via any of THREE signals: TUNNEL (thick roof above), CANYON (clean massif flanks both sides, axis scan 16), or **CLOSENESS (majority-mass neighborhood: >=55% mountain within radius 8 — ragged cave-pocked mountains with no clean walls; user mechanic round 11; one-sided hugs excluded by the half-plane bound)**. Per-stretch verdict: all-outflow = FullLift; inflow+outflow = PartialLift (upstream ~10-cell tunnel apron, downstream lifts, falls at the exit face); inflow-only / enclosed / unclassifiable = vanilla. Lift = seal solid below + carve sky (water/banks/rim) + lips/bases. ExecuteLift shared + idempotent.
- **AUTO SKY GENERATION:** qualifying player home maps auto-generate the sky post-mapgen (same tri-signal + verdict classifier, roof-based).
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED (round 7).

## RIVER v7 (round 12: mountain closeness) — built compile-green, RELAUNCH PENDING
Round-11 live example: river flowing north through a RAGGED cave-riddled mountain — no clean flanks, so canyon detection missed it. v7 adds the closeness signal (MountainClose density test) to all three predicate sites (genstep, auto-gen qualifier, force-lift StretchAt). The user's example map should now classify: apron at the south inflow, massif sealed solid, sky river, waterfall off the north face.

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · lift + falls machinery (USER round 9). v5 fringe seal, v6 per-face, v7 closeness pending verify.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: force lift river (click water) · AB: river diagnostic · AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## Test plan (round 12)
1. The user's ragged-mountain river map (or any): auto sky OR force-lift; verify apron mouth, solid massif, sky river, falls at the outflow face; river diagnostic verdict line.
2. Standing stack afterward: below lighting, animal flow, direct-to-blueprint, BAM, Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting · animal flow fix · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit · mountain rivers v7 (tri-signal detection, per-face verdicts, auto sky, force-lift tool) · Batch B/C built pending. SKYLIGHTS REMOVED.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (21st pass): **mountain-closeness detection built compile-green** — ragged mountains now classify alongside tunnels and canyons. Awaiting relaunch.
